clue.text: See very fast start

parts.note: to see a point is to get it, understand it
a cracking pace is a very fast one

explanation.surface: An instruction to watch a sprinter burst away at the gun.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to begin work briskly, so it can stand for an urgent start.

clue.text: Allure of grand Hollywood actress

parts.note: G is the slang abbreviation for a grand, a thousand
Dorothy Lamour starred in the Hollywood Road films

explanation.surface: The magnetic appeal of a great film star of the golden age.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: both name an attractive, alluring quality.

clue.text: Find and copy

definitions.meaning: to locate something lost by tracking it down
to reproduce a drawing by following its lines through thin paper

explanation.surface: Instructions for locating and reproducing something.
explanation.definitionFit: One verb covers both tracking down a missing thing and copying lines through tissue.

clue.text: Clear-headed on trial, a criminal

indicators.note: criminal suggests these letters have been treated wrongly and so rearranged

explanation.surface: A defendant in the dock stays calm and lucid despite being a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: someone clear-headed thinks sensibly and logically.

clue.text: Musical about pianist Dame Myra

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
Dame Myra Hess was a famous British concert pianist

explanation.surface: A stage show telling the life of a celebrated pianist.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the 1980s stage musical by Tim Rice and the ABBA songwriters bears this title.

clue.text: Cross put in ground, by order

parts.note: to inter is to bury in the earth
a religious order or sect

explanation.surface: A cross is planted in the soil, following a ruling.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: lines that cross each other meet at a point.

clue.text: Good variety in farm

parts.note: a range of goods is a variety of them

explanation.surface: A farm offering a wholesome mix of produce.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a country house with farm buildings attached, a homestead.

clue.text: In charge in Italian city, woman …

indicators.note: the second 'in' places one piece within the other

parts.note: Verona is a city in northern Italy
IC is the usual abbreviation for in charge, the person responsible

explanation.surface: A woman running things in an Italian city, the clue running on into the next.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a common female first name.

clue.text: … set off, all upset to see girl

indicators.note: off suggests the word set has gone wrong and is jumbled
in a down clue, upset means the word all is turned upside down, read bottom to top

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue: a woman sets off, distressed, to visit a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' turns SET into STE; 'upset' flips ALL to LLA.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a common female first name.

clue.text: Not living together, guys before beginning to tenant flat

indicators.note: before puts the earlier pieces ahead of the next one

parts.note: a separated couple live apart
guys are men

indicators.note: beginning to picks the opening letter of tenant

explanation.surface: Separated men take a flat ahead of a new tenant.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a flat is an apartment, the American word for a rented dwelling.

clue.text: Master, extremely disagreeable in a gym

indicators.note: in places the extreme letters inside the other pieces

parts.note: PT, physical training, is the school gym lesson

indicators.note: extremely takes the outermost letters of disagreeable

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster who is horribly unpleasant in the gym.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a master of a craft is an expert.

clue.text: Difficult, old emperor coming to America

parts.note: Nero was a Roman emperor
US, the United States

explanation.surface: An ancient ruler making a troublesome trip to the New World.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a burdensome task is hard going.

clue.text: Toy dog lost during short march

indicators.note: during puts one piece inside the other
short means the last letter of the synonym is cut off

parts.note: a protest march is a rally

indicators.note: lost suggests the letters of dog are astray and rearranged

explanation.surface: A little dog goes missing during a brief demonstration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Toy' looks like it describes the dog, but it is the definition; 'short' trims the march to RALL and 'lost' scrambles the dog to GDO.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a floppy cloth doll is a child's toy.

clue.text: Doctor shown with maiden, a character in pantomime?

parts.note: to doctor results is to rig them
M is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for a maiden over
a character in a play is a role

explanation.surface: A medic appears alongside a young woman as one of the cast of a Christmas show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' is a verb here, falsify. A pantomime is a British family Christmas stage show, hence a farcical fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: Figurative sense: a pantomime is a long, absurd performance or palaver.

clue.text: Riding or running in sports field in America

indicators.note: running suggests the letters are on the move, rearranged

explanation.surface: Choosing between horse riding and jogging on an American pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the American football field is nicknamed for its grid of yard lines.

clue.text: Prudent to support unmarried mother in a different way?

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits below the other
unmarried means without M, the abbreviation for married

parts.note: prudent means wise

explanation.surface: A sensible person backs a single mother in an unconventional manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: in a manner other than this one, differently.

clue.text: From Elvis, anniversary card

indicators.note: From signals the letters are taken from inside the following words

explanation.surface: A greetings card for an Elvis anniversary.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a credit card brand, as well as an entry permit stamped in a passport.

clue.text: Something for breakfast time?

definitions.meaning: an oatmeal dish eaten in the morning
British slang for a prison sentence, doing time

explanation.surface: Asking whether it is the hour for the morning meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'time' here means a spell in jail, from the British slang that also named a 1970s prison sitcom.
explanation.definitionFit: The oat dish is breakfast food, and in British slang the word also means a prison term.

clue.text: Barrister cutting fine cheese

indicators.note: cutting means a piece is removed from the synonym

parts.note: brief is informal for a barrister
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A lawyer slicing up a good cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a soft French cheese.

clue.text: Live number heard earlier

parts.note: to live is to be, exist

indicators.note: heard says the number is taken by its sound

parts.note: four is a number

explanation.surface: A live act's number was heard previously.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: both mean at an earlier time.

clue.text: Stew at last in bistro? A controversial issue

parts.note: a Lancashire hotpot is a meat and potato stew

indicators.note: last in takes the final letter of bistro

explanation.surface: Whether a stew belongs in a bistro becomes a heated argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a contentious matter is one too awkward to handle, passed on quickly.

clue.text: Satellite perhaps bore it out — Russia's first

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are thrown out of order
first takes the opening letter of Russia

explanation.surface: A satellite launched by Russia, which got there first.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a craft circling a planet, as a satellite does.

clue.text: Sound level in the auditorium

indicators.note: an auditorium is where words are heard, so it means by ear

parts.note: a level line is straight

explanation.surface: Even acoustics in a concert hall.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a sound is a narrow channel of sea between two land masses.

clue.text: Piece of deep-fried food is more appropriate? That's about right

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other

parts.note: fitter means more fitting

explanation.surface: Asking whether a deep-fried morsel is more suitable, and being told roughly yes.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a fried slice of fruit or vegetable in batter.

clue.text: Alarm worried Rupert Bear, initially

indicators.note: worried suggests the name is agitated into a new order
initially takes the first letter of Bear

explanation.surface: The children's cartoon bear is anxious about something.
explanation.walkthrough: Rupert Bear is a British children's comic-strip character.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to alarm someone is to upset them.

clue.text: Model daughter put forward

parts.note: to model for an artist is to pose

explanation.surface: A model's daughter was put forward for a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a question posed is one raised or put forward.

clue.text: Vessel about to be destroyed

indicators.note: destroyed means the letters of about are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A ship on the point of being sunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a German submarine is a seagoing vessel.

clue.text: Wine jar I smashed tackling opening of ordinaire

indicators.note: tackling means grappling with, holding the other piece inside
smashed suggests the letters are broken and rearranged
opening of takes the first letter of ordinaire

explanation.surface: Someone breaks a jar while opening a bottle of cheap table wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a red wine from northern Spain.

clue.text: Home eleven dismissed? Comprehensively

parts.note: at home means in
a cricket or football eleven is a side
a dismissed batter is out

explanation.surface: A cricket question: was the home team all out?
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to know something thoroughly, in every detail, is to know it completely.

clue.text: One leading the way in movement — crossword compiler

parts.note: a trend is a general movement in a direction
a setter compiles crosswords

explanation.surface: A pioneering crossword compiler leads a movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a pioneer whose style others copy leads fashion.
